**Introduction:**
A brief description of the dataset and its main variables.
The dataset numbats.csv records numbat sighting in Australia. It includes the time it was sighted (month, day, year, etc.) as well as the longitude and latitude that the numbat was sighted at.

The research question you are trying to answer related to this dataset
Where are numbats sighted most in Australia and in what season are they sighted in the most? 

**Analysis:**
A section in which you answer that question using R coding skills you've learned. This will include code chunks as well as brief description of what each of those code chunks is doing.

This section should include at least two visualizations (graphs/maps) relevant to your research question.

```{r}
numbat_clean <- read.csv("data/numbats.csv") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(decimalLongitude) & !is.na(decimalLatitude))
  
numbat_sp <-numbat_clean %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"), 
           crs = 7844, 
           remove = FALSE)

tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(numbat_sp) +
  tm_dots()

numbat_df <- numbat_sp %>%
  st_set_geometry(NULL)

numbat_month_observations <- numbat_df %>%
  count(month)

numbat_month_observations_season <- numbat_month_observations %>%
  mutate(season = case_when(
    month %in% c("Sep", "Oct", "Nov") ~ "Spring",
    month %in% c("Dec", "Jan", "Feb") ~ "Summer",
    month %in% c("Mar", "Apr", "May") ~ "Fall",
    month %in% c("Jun", "Jul", "Aug") ~ "Winter"
  ))

ggplot(numbat_month_observations_season, aes(x = season, y = n, fill = month)) +
  geom_col()

numbat_season_group <- numbat_month_observations_season %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarize(count = sum(n))

```

**Discussion:**
The season that the most number of sightings for numbats is in Spring with a total number of 283, which can be seen in the dataframe numbate_season_group. The number of sightings in Summer, Fall, and Winter are 208, 29, and 17, respectively. Additionally, numbats are tend to be found in Perth, Australia according to the map numbat_sp. 

**Tie to Class:**
In this assignment, I filtered the data by month and found the count of observations for each month. Additionally, I loaded spatial data into R and displayed it using tmap. I also displayed the seasons that numbat sightings were recorded in using ggplot via a bar graph.
